svg.title: Drywall handling bar and driver interface, dimensions in millimetres
svg.text: Removable carrying bar and depth-stop tool
All dimensions in mm. Use the figures for fabrication; these views are dimensioned schematics.
Bar 12 deep × 8 high. Steel button heads 4 × 4 × 1.8 on 1.8 square stems, centred 38 either side.
Grip centre 65 to the side of bar centre. Rubber-faced jaw web 62 × 48 × 36; carrier body 72 g in simulation.
Pin spans the board. Leave 0.65 clearance between rear paper and inner head.
Room face at x = 37.65 relative to the carrier origin; board thickness 12.7.
Lower the handle by 13 to line both heads up with the wide slot entries.
Housing and spindle 310 g; sliding nose 35 g. Grip diameter about 36.
Return stroke 34. Full seating stroke approximately 31.75.
PH2 bit, 48 extension, 12 collated #6 screws; bit behind nose at rest.
Both views are task-designed adapters. Use matched commercial feed and drive parts for a physical screwgun; verify clearance on the chosen rig.
